messages:
mark_g: Hi — signed up yesterday, verified email, added card, but free trial credits never showed. Account email: mark@acme.co. Any ideas?
signup-bot: New signup: mark@acme.co — email: verified; payment method: card added; 3DS status: challenge_failed.
jess_support: hey @mark_g — sorry about that. Quick questions: what country is the billing card from and where were you when you signed up? 3DS failures + BIN/geo mismatch often trigger a promo hold.
mark_g: billing country = UK. I was travelling and signed up from a US wifi. 3DS flow popped a "challenge failed" but my bank didn't charge. I verified email but didn't add phone number.
jess_support: thanks. I'm going to pull the account flags and 3DS log. @oscar_billing can you take a look at the payment gating for mark@acme.co?
oscar_billing: pulling logs now... 3DS result = CHALLENGE_FAILED at 2026-03-14T22:11:03Z. BIN country = GB, geoip = US. Risk engine auto-held promo: reason=PM_BIN_COUNTRY_MISMATCH. No prior manual overrides on the account.
jess_support: ok, that matches what we see. policy requires manual review for BIN/geo mismatch. @emma_finance can we do a manual credits grant after verifying identity? customer already completed email verification.
emma_finance: we'll need a quick second factor or last4 to confirm. @mark_g please either paste the last4 of the card here or DM me so we don't expose full details. If you prefer, a short selfie + ID works but last4 is fastest.
mark_g: last4 = 4242. happy to DM if you want — sending in thread to speed things up. Company domain is acme.co (this is my company email).
oscar_billing: verified last4 against tokenized payment method — matches. No charge was attempted. I can clear the promo hold and issue the trial credits now. Doing manual grant...
oscar_billing: done — credited 50 trial units at 2026-03-15T01:05:42Z. @mark_g check your dashboard; you might need to refresh. Internal note added: manual_grant; override_reason=BIN_GEO_OVERRIDE; ticket_ref=SUP-8742.
mark_g: I see the credits now, thank you! Any idea why the 3DS said it failed? I approved the push notification on my banking app and it looked successful.
jess_support: 3DS can show challenge_failed if the challenge window timed out or if the auth came back after our gateway timeout. Combined with BIN/geo mismatch it triggered the hold. I'll open a follow-up with infra to review 3DS timing/windows.
jess_support: closing loop here — glad we got you unstuck. If anything else pops up, ping me. :pray:
